metadata.scenario_context: Adam has won a scholarship to study at a prestigious university. His friends plan to hold a celebration party in his honor.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from USA strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Mongolia strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of buying a bottle of champagne as a gift for Adam's celebration.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Adam's scholarship award celebration.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly
shared_prefix.message: Omar, I was thinking, for Adam's celebration, we should get him a nice bottle of champagne. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Omar
shared_prefix.message: I think a traditional Mongolian gift would be more meaningful, like a nice cashmere scarf or a horse statue, something that represents our culture and shows respect to his achievement, my parents would be proud if I bring a thoughtful gift like that.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly
shared_prefix.message: I'm not sure about that, Omar. Champagne is classic for celebrations and Adam would probably appreciate it. Besides, I don't really think about what my parents would think when it comes to my goals or actions, that's not really a driving force for me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Omar
shared_prefix.message: For me, making my parents proud is everything, it's what drives me to succeed, and I think a traditional gift would show Adam that I put thought into it, my parents would be happy to know I'm respecting our traditions, and that's what matters most to me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly
shared_prefix.message: I don't know... I just don't think making my parents proud is that big of a deal to me, I mean, I want to make myself happy and do my own thing. And I still think champagne is a better idea for Adam's party, it's more of a celebration thing.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Omar
shared_prefix.message: I understand that you think differently, but for me, my parents' pride is everything, it's a big deal, and I will always consider their feelings and expectations, I think I'll go with the cashmere scarf, it's a more personal and meaningful gift, and it will make my parents proud.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly
shared_prefix.message: I'm just not on the same page as you when it comes to that... I don't think my goals in life have been to make my parents proud, that's not something I've ever really thought about. Anyway, back to Adam's gift, are you sure he'd even like a scarf?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Omar
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here, people figure it out, and at the end of the day it's all the same, doesn't matter to me, so let's just live and let live, I think we should focus on getting a nice gift for Adam, as long as we're speaking the same language, we can make this work, and I'm sure with experience you can handle any situation, so what do you think about getting him a scarf or something?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Kelly
turns.message: I still think champagne would be better, it's just more of a celebration thing, you know? And I don't think we should just settle on something because it's easy, I really think Adam would appreciate the champagne more. Can't we just get that instead?
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.message: I'm not trying to settle, I just think the scarf is a more thoughtful gift, and it's what my parents would want me to get, they would be proud if I bring a traditional gift, and that's important to me, I'm not going to change my mind about this, a scarf is what I'm getting.
turns.label: Defense

positive.mediator_utterance: I'm curious about something - it seems like you both care deeply about showing respect to Adam, just in different ways. Omar, could you tell me a bit more about what the cashmere scarf symbolizes in your cultural tradition? And Kelly, what makes champagne feel like the right celebration gesture to you? I'd love to hear the stories behind your gift ideas.

turns.speaker: Mediator
turns.message: I'm curious about something - it seems like you both care deeply about showing respect to Adam, just in different ways. Omar, could you tell me a bit more about what the cashmere scarf symbolizes in your cultural tradition? And Kelly, what makes champagne feel like the right celebration gesture to you? I'd love to hear the stories behind your gift ideas.

turns.speaker: Kelly
turns.message: I think champagne symbolizes celebration and achievement. It’s like a universal way to toast to someone's success, and I feel it matches the festive vibe of the party. To me, it's about celebrating Adam's hard work in a way that feels exciting and joyful.
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.message: For me, the cashmere scarf symbolizes warmth and respect. In my culture, gifting something that represents our heritage shows appreciation for someone's achievements in a deeper way. It’s a reminder of how important family and traditions are to me, and it would mean a lot to my parents to see me honoring those values while celebrating Adam.
turns.label: Acceptance
